courses.title: Crystal Ball: Gold Edition
courses.excerpt: In this "Gold Edition," professional Day Trader & Coach, Pat Mitchell, introduces live trades captured over a nine month period. You will learn about natural movement theory, trend identification, managing trades during technological failures, advanced trade management, and holding ground in stressful situations. Quizzes throughout the course aid in information retention, with the goal of making the trading process more actionable. This is a course you will want to take again and again throughout your professional trading career!

courses.title: Crystal Ball: Volume 1
courses.description: Crystal Ball will help day traders understand and predict market actions without relying on algorithms or AI. You will learn to dissect market actions through live examples which demonstrate how to forecast market movements accurately.
courses.excerpt: Trick Trades Crystal Ball is an in-depth price action dissection of live market action where Pat Mitchell Draws out what will happen prior to happening. Full in-depth lessons where you can learn to “see the future”

courses.title: Trick's Behind the Trade Application: Members
courses.description: Overview: Get "Behind the Trade" with me, Professional Day Trader "Trick" Mitchell, where I get struggling traders to stop doing stupid shit. If selected, I will personally coach you on not only a recent trade of your choosing, but also on the thoughts and emotions that influenced your trading decisions. To qualify, you must agree to be on camera and potentially answer some uncomfortable questions. This is an incredible opportunity to have your skills and emotions evaluated and guided by one of the best trading coaches you can find. I ask that you approach this opportunity with full transparency, along with a willingness to be helped, tested and pushed beyond your limits.
